entry.title: SEC proposes expanding securities eligible for cross trading by registered funds
entry.summary: SEC Proposes Expanding Securities Eligible for Cross Trading by Registered Funds SEC · Oct 9, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe SEC proposed amendments to Rule 17a-7 under the Investment Company Act, which governs cross trades between registered funds and certain affiliates. The proposal would expand eligible securities, including most fixed-income securities, and modernize pricing and oversight conditions. It would also require aggregated reporting of trading activity and cross trades on Forms N-PORT and N-MFP. entry.title: Recap of the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon 2026) co-hosted by the CFTC and Kansas State University
entry.summary: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · ReportCFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig and Kansas State University's Risk Management Center co-hosted a two-day agricultural commodity futures conference in Overland Park, Kansas, in late October 2026. entry.title: CFTC sues Utah to block state enforcement against its registered markets
entry.summary: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · EnforcementThe Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has sued Utah to stop the state from using state laws to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets. Utah had earlier filed civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said event contracts serve hedging and investment purposes and also inform the public about future outcomes, and the agency will defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives.

entry.title: CFTC to publish Commitments of Traders report twice a week
entry.summary: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report CFTC · Oct 27, 2026CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced plans to raise the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders (COT) Report from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Monday data will be published Wednesday and Wednesday data Friday, both at 3:30 p.m. ET, reducing reporting latency from three days to two. The change follows a Request for Comment and aims to give market participants more timely information on agricultural market positions.

entry.title: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the defendants held themselves out as an investment club providing investors with an affordable solution that offered easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading」 The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his firm EminiFX Inc. to pay about $228.6 million in restitution, $15 million in disgorgement, and a $45.1 million penalty. The court found EminiFX was a Ponzi scheme that marketed easy access to cryptocurrency and Forex trading. As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors. Alexandre is serving a nine-year prison sentence in a parallel criminal case.

entry.title: IRS reminder to protect tax information from identity theft
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Take steps now to protect tax information IRS · Oct 22, 2026 · GuidanceThe IRS urges taxpayers to protect their online account credentials and obtain an Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN) to prevent tax-related identity theft. The IRS Individual Online Account shows recently filed returns, refund status, payments, and tax records, so taxpayers should not share their sign-in information. An IP PIN is a six-digit number that blocks others from filing a federal return using the taxpayer's Social Security number or ITIN. Taxpayers planning to file early in 2027 should request one before the online system's mid-November maintenance outage.

entry.title: CFTC Grants No-Action Relief for Converting Perpetual-Style Index Futures to True Perpetuals
entry.summary: CFTC Issues No-Action Letter for DCMs Regarding Converting Existing Perpetual-Style Broad-Based Security Index Futures into True Perpetual Futures CFTC · Oct 6, 2026 · GuidanceThe CFTC's Division of Market Oversight granted no-action relief allowing designated contract markets to remove expiration dates from existing perpetual-style broad-based security index futures, converting them into true perpetual contracts. The conversion takes effect once customer protection and procedural conditions are met, including soliciting feedback from holders of open positions, giving advance notice and an opportunity to exit, providing appropriate risk disclosures, and leaving other material terms unchanged.
